title: ר' תנחום בר חייא

paragraphs: R' Tanhum bar Hiyya: Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 24; Vayikra Rabbah, section 15. In that matter in Kohelet, at “It goes to the south,” R' Hiyya bar Tanhum appears to be a scribal error. R' Aha in R' Tanhum son of R' Hiyya's name: “In R' Yehoshua ben Levi's days they sought to abolish immersion …”: Jerusalem Mi she-Metu, mishnah 4. R' Eliezer son of R' Yose in R' Tanhum bar Hiyya's name: Jerusalem Ma'asrot 1:3. This requires examination, for R' Eliezer son of R' Yose preceded him by much. He went up to R' Hinena bar Pappa. R' Hananyah bar Adda reports in his name. In R' Yehoshua ben Levi's name: Shekalim, beginning of chapter 3. R' Yonah reports in his name: Jerusalem Ein Omedin, mishnah 1. R' Mana in Tzipporin was his teacher: Shevi'it 6:1. In R' Simlai's name: Shekalim 4:3; and the end of Ein Omedin, R' Tanhuma bar Hiyya.
